metadata.dataset: Big Four & Major Brick-and-Mortar National Banks — Standard Savings & Relationship Tiers

accounts.relationship_or_promo_apy: 0.01% (No relationship rate bump on basic Chase Savings)
accounts.fee_waiver_requirements: $300+ daily beginning balance, OR $25+ monthly Autosave/repeating transfer from Chase checking, OR linked Chase Premier Plus / Sapphire / Private Client checking, OR linked Chase College Checking for Overdraft Protection, OR owner under age 25.
accounts.active_bonus_or_promotion: Up to $200 New Savings Customer Bonus: Earn $100 when depositing $5,000–$9,999.99 OR $200 when depositing $10,000+ in new money within 30 days and maintaining for 90 days (Offer expires 2027-01-27).
accounts.flag_notes: Official rate sheet PDF (rdin1.pdf, effective 2026-10-16) confirms 0.01% APY across all tiers. On savingsoffer promo page, footnote text omits the APY number ('effective as of 09/18/2026, is  for all balances').

accounts.fee_waiver_requirements: $15,000+ beginning daily balance, OR linked to Chase Premier Plus Checking℠, Chase Sapphire® Checking, or Chase Private Client Checking℠.
accounts.relationship_qualification_rules: Link to J.P. Morgan Private Client Checking Plus, J.P. Morgan Classic Checking, Chase Private Client Checking, Chase Sapphire Checking, or Chase Premier Plus Checking AND complete at least 5 customer-initiated checking transactions per monthly statement period.
accounts.active_bonus_or_promotion: Eligible for Chase Private Client combined new-money bonus offers when bundled with Private Client Checking.
accounts.flag_notes: Even at $250,000+ with a linked Premier/Private Client checking account and 5 monthly transactions, the relationship rate is 0.02% APY ($50/yr on $250k).

accounts.monthly_service_fee: $0 (when linked to Chase Private Client Checking)
accounts.fee_waiver_requirements: Linked to Chase Private Client Checking ($150,000+ combined average daily balance required to avoid checking $35 monthly fee).
accounts.relationship_qualification_rules: Link to J.P. Morgan Private Client Checking Plus, J.P. Morgan Classic Checking, or Chase Private Client Checking.
accounts.active_bonus_or_promotion: Up to $3,000 Chase Private Client Checking + Savings new money bonus (requires $250,000–$500,000+ across qualifying accounts).
accounts.flag_notes: All tiers up to $1,000,000+ earn 0.02% APY relationship rate per rdin1.pdf.

accounts.tier_type: Standard & BofA Rewards™ (formerly Preferred Rewards) Savings
accounts.fee_waiver_requirements: Waived for first 6 months on new accounts; thereafter waived with $500+ minimum daily balance, linked Advantage Relationship Checking, enrolled in Preferred Rewards / BofA Rewards™, or owner under age 25.
accounts.relationship_qualification_rules: Effective May 26, 2026, Preferred Rewards transitioned to BofA Rewards™ (Member <$30k, Preferred Plus $30k+, Preferred Honors $100k+, Premier $1M+) and the Preferred Rewards Savings Interest Rate Booster (5%/10%/20% lift to 0.02%/0.03%/0.04% APY) was disclosed for discontinuation.
accounts.active_bonus_or_promotion: 6-month monthly fee waiver on new accounts; no public cash sign-up bonus on Advantage Savings.
accounts.flag_notes: 1) Official disclosures state that on or about May 26, 2026, Preferred Rewards became BofA Rewards™ and the Advantage Savings interest rate booster was discontinued, while Marcus comparison table (as of 2026-10-20) and BofA Business pages still show 0.04% APY for Platinum Honors. 2) Charges $10 Withdrawal Limit Fee per withdrawal exceeding 6 per monthly statement cycle.

accounts.fee_waiver_requirements: $300 minimum daily balance, OR 1+ Save As You Go® transfer from linked Wells Fargo checking, OR primary owner age 24 or under.
accounts.relationship_qualification_rules: None — flat 0.01% APY across all balances.
accounts.active_bonus_or_promotion: None on Way2Save (Promotional 3.25%–3.50% APY requires Platinum Savings).
accounts.flag_notes: Confirmed 0.01% APY on wellsfargo.com/savings-cds/rates/ (CA 94105 location context).

accounts.account_name: Wells Fargo Platinum Savings (Standard / Relationship vs New Customer Promo)
accounts.relationship_or_promo_apy: 0.02% (Prime Checking) | 0.05% (Premier Checking) | 3.25% APY (New Customer $25k+ Online) | 3.50% APY (12-Mo Banker Promo $10k+)
accounts.fee_waiver_requirements: $3,500 minimum daily balance each fee period.
accounts.relationship_qualification_rules: Link to Wells Fargo Prime Checking (0.02% APY) or Premier Checking (0.05% APY). New savings customers (no WF savings in past 30 days) who deposit >=$25,000 within 30 days and maintain >=$25,000 daily earn 3.25% variable APY (3.20% interest rate).
accounts.active_bonus_or_promotion: 3.25% APY New Customer variable rate on >=$25,000 (online/branch, excludes CO); OR 3.50% APY 12-Month Promotional Interest Rate when enrolled with a banker with >=$10,000 new money (4.00% APY in Cook, DuPage, Lake counties, IL).
accounts.annual_return_on_250k_base: $8,125.00 (at 3.25% New Customer APY) | $125.00 (at 0.05% Existing Premier APY)
accounts.flag_notes: If balance falls below $25,000 on any day, rate drops from 3.25% APY to 0.01%–0.05% APY.

accounts.relationship_or_promo_apy: 0.06% (Citi Priority) | 0.09% (Citigold) | 0.12% (Citigold Private Client) | 0.98%–1.05% APY (Premium Boost on $25k–$499k)
accounts.apy_at_250k: 0.03% (Standard) to 1.05% (Citigold Private Client w/ Premium Boost)
accounts.fee_waiver_requirements: $500+ Average Monthly Balance, OR linked Citibank checking account, OR Citi Priority ($30k+), Citigold ($200k+), or Citigold Private Client ($1M+) Relationship Tier.
accounts.relationship_qualification_rules: Combined Average Monthly Balance (CAMB): Citi Priority ($30,000–$199,999.99), Citigold ($200,000–$999,999.99), Citigold Private Client ($1,000,000+). Premium Boost requires opting in and completing monthly Premium Boost Required Activities.
accounts.active_bonus_or_promotion: DISCONTINUATION NOTICE: Per Citi Simplified Banking Fact Sheet (dated 10/01/2026), 'Effective October 23, 2026, Promotional Rate Feature for New Citi Savings accounts will be discontinued.'
accounts.annual_return_on_250k_base: $75.00 (at 0.03% NYC Standard) | $2,625.00 (at 1.05% Citigold Private Client Premium Boost)
accounts.opportunity_cost_vs_top_hysa_250k_yr1: -$9,249.62 (at 0.03% NYC Standard vs Barclays Tiered Savings $9,324.62)
accounts.verification_status: Needs Review (Promotional Rate Feature Discontinued Effective 2026-10-23)
accounts.flag_notes: Critical timing alert for accounts opened 2026-10-22: Citibank's Simplified Banking Fact Sheet (10/01/2026) explicitly announces that the Promotional Rate Feature for New Citi Savings accounts is discontinued effective October 23, 2026.

accounts.relationship_qualification_rules: Earn $5 savings reward each month in Year 1 that the collected balance grows by at least $200 (max $60 reward in first year).
accounts.active_bonus_or_promotion: Up to $60 Year-1 Savings Reward ($5/month for 12 months when balance increases by >=$200/month).
accounts.opportunity_cost_vs_top_hysa_250k_yr1: -$9,239.62 (vs Barclays Tiered Savings $9,324.62) | -$7,415.00 (vs BMO's own Alto Online Savings at 3.00% APY = $7,500.00)
accounts.verification_status: Verified (Effective Date Blank on Webpage Footnote Flagged)
accounts.flag_notes: On bmo.com/en-us/main/personal/bank-accounts/savings-and-cds/, Footnote 3 has a blank effective date string ('effective as of , and are subject to change... 0.01% for all balances'), while the Reg DD PDF is dated October 2026.
